WITH 
-- Satın alınan ürünlerin toplam adetleri
satilan_adet AS (
    SELECT 
        sk.urun_id,
        SUM(sk.adet) as toplam_satis_adeti
    FROM siparis_kalemleri sk
    GROUP BY sk.urun_id
),
-- İade edilen ürünlerin toplam adetleri
iade_edilen_adet AS (
    SELECT 
        i.urun_id,
        SUM(i.adet) as toplam_iade_adeti
    FROM iadeler i
    GROUP BY i.urun_id
),
-- Her ürün için net satış verileri
net_satis AS (
    SELECT 
        u.id AS urun_id,
        u.ad AS urun_adi,
        COALESCE(sa.toplam_satis_adeti, 0) AS satilan_adet,
        COALESCE(ia.toplam_iade_adeti, 0) AS iade_edilen_adet,
        COALESCE(sa.toplam_satis_adeti, 0) - COALESCE(ia.toplam_iade_adeti, 0) AS net_adet
    FROM urunler u
    LEFT JOIN satilan_adet sa ON u.id = sa.urun_id
    LEFT JOIN iade_edilen_adet ia ON u.id = ia.urun_id
),
-- Net ciro hesaplama (sipariş kalemlerine göre)
net_ciro AS (
    SELECT 
        sk.urun_id,
        SUM((sk.adet - COALESCE(i.adet, 0)) * sk.birim_fiyat) AS net_ciro
    FROM siparis_kalemleri sk
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT siparis_id, urun_id, SUM(adet) as adet
        FROM iadeler
        GROUP BY siparis_id, urun_id
    ) i ON sk.siparis_id = i.siparis_id AND sk.urun_id = i.urun_id
    GROUP BY sk.urun_id
)
SELECT 
    ns.urun_adi,
    ROUND(ns.net_adet, 2) AS net_adet,
    ROUND(nc.net_ciro, 2) AS net_ciro
FROM net_satis ns
JOIN net_ciro nc ON ns.urun_id = nc.urun_id
ORDER BY nc.net_ciro DESC, ns.urun_adi ASC
LIMIT 5;

3. Net ciro = (satılan adet - iade edilen adet) × birim_fiyat toplamı
